source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of interference and coherence (PDF 47-49).

blocks.text: Jab aik wavelength ki do lehrein kisi nuqte par milti hain to superposition ka usool kehta hai ke nateeja displacement un ke alag displacements ka jor hai. Kisi ilaqe mein milne wali do coherent lehrein kuch nuqton par aik doosre ko taqwiyat aur kuch par khatam karti hain, aur interference naam ka naqsha banta hai. Aik frequency aur wavelength ki awaz paida karne wale do loudspeakers lein jo aik hi source se jure hon taake in phase lehrein chhorein. Kuch nuqton par dono lehrein barabar amplitude ke saath in phase pohanchti hain; nateeje ka amplitude aik lehar ka dugna aur awaz unchi hoti hai. Doosre nuqton par yeh aadha chakkar peeche pohanch kar aik doosre ko khatam karti hain aur awaz dheemi hoti hai (Fig 15.3).

items: Lehrein aik hi qism ki hon: awaz ki lehrein sirf awaz ki lehron se interference karti hain.
Lehrein coherent hon, yani un ka phase farq constant ho.
Lehrein aik hi, ya taqreeban aik hi, simt mein chal rahi hon.

blocks.text: Mukhtalif amplitude ki lehrein bhi interference karti hain, lekin roshan aur andhere (ya unchi aur dheemi) jagahon ka farq kam ho jata hai.

blocks.alt: Displacement (10^-4 m ki ikai mein, -4 se 4) aur waqt ke teen graph. (a) Amplitude 2 ki neeli aur sabz lehrein aik doosre ke oopar; gulabi nateeja amplitude 4. (b) Amplitude 2 ki neeli aur sabz lehrein aadhe chakkar ke farq par; nateeja waqt ke mehwar par seedhi lakeer. (c) Amplitude 1 ki neeli aur amplitude 2 ki sabz lehar hum-qadam; gulabi nateeja amplitude 3.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.3: Superposition se lehron ka jor. Barabar amplitude ki lehrein (a) constructive ya (b) destructive interference deti hain; (c) mukhtalif amplitude ki lehrein bhi constructive interference kar sakti hain (kitab ki Figure 15.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki (b) mein doosri lehar gulabi rang mein hai, jo baqi graphs mein nateeje (resultant) ka rang hai; asal nateeja sifar wali seedhi lakeer hai. Kitab ki (c) mein 1 aur 2 amplitude ki lehron ka nateeja taqreeban 4 tak chhapa hai, jabke jor 1 + 2 = 3 hona chahiye. Khaake mein (b) ki dono lehrein neeli aur sabz hain aur (c) ka nateeja 3 hai.

Hum bohat si lehron se ghire hain, jaise nazar aane wali roshni, infrared, radio lehrein aur awaz, phir bhi hum har waqt interference ke naqshe nahi dekhte. Rozmarra mein interference nazar aa sakti hai, maslan dhund wali raat mein street lamps ya chaand ke gird roshni ke halqe, ya kapre ke peeche se tez roshni dekhne par roshan aur andhere patte, lekin napne ke qabil asraat ke liye aam taur par khaas intizam chahiye. Agar do loudspeakers mukhtalif signal generators se jure hon jin ki frequencies thori mukhtalif hon to lehrein in phase shuru ho kar jald out of phase ho jayengi (Fig 15.4); hum unchi, phir dheemi, phir unchi awaz sunenge, aur naqsha kamre mein khisakta rahega.

blocks.alt: Thori mukhtalif wavelength ki gulabi aur neeli lehar ka displacement aur waqt. Dono 0 se shuru; pehli chotiyan saath (in phase). Phir woh hat-ti jati hain, yahan tak ke dashed khari lakeer (out of phase) par neeli ki chotti gulabi ke garhe se milti hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.4: Thori mukhtalif wavelengths ki lehrein, is liye aik doosre ke saath phase mein aati aur phase se nikalti hain (kitab ki Figure 15.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Coherent sources
blocks.text: Coherent sources aisi lehrein chhorte hain jin ka phase farq constant ho. Do lehrein constant phase farq sirf tab rakh sakti hain jab un ki frequencies aik jaisi aur mustaqil hon. Dono loudspeakers ko aik hi signal generator se jorna unhein coherent sources banata hai.

Aik frequency ke do lasers kaam nahi denge: laser ki roshni bohat se alag jhonkon (bursts) se bani hai, aur yeh yaqeeni nahi ke do lasers ke jhonke in phase rahein. Yeh masla aik laser use kar ke us ki roshni do slits se baant kar hal hota hai (Fig 15.5). Slits constant phase farq wale do coherent sources ban jate hain. Agar woh coherent na hon to naqsha aankh ke liye bohat tezi se badalta, aur hum sirf yaksan roshni ki patti dekhte jis mein wazeh roshan aur andhere hisse na hote.

blocks.alt: Teen surkh lehron ke silsile. Oopar wale mein phase ki achanak tabdeeli (sudden change of phase) teer se dikhayi gayi hai. Beech wale silsile par double slit wali neeli slide khari hai. Teenon ko kaatne wali khari lakeer dikhati hai ke phase ki tabdeeli har aik mein aik hi jagah hoti hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.5: Saaf interference naqshe ke liye lehron ka coherent hona zaruri hai (kitab ki Figure 15.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Laser ki roshni chhote chhote jhonkon (bursts) mein aati hai aur har naye jhonke par phase achanak badal jata hai. Do alag lasers ke jhonke aapas mein mel nahi khate. Aik hi laser ki roshni double slit se do hisson mein bant jaye to dono hisson mein phase ki tabdeeli bilkul aik saath hoti hai, is liye un ka phase farq constant rehta hai: yehi coherent sources hain.

blocks.prompt: Do lampon ki roshni screen par pare to interference naqsha kyun nazar nahi aata?
blocks.explanation: Do lampon ki roshni coherent nahi: is ka phase farq be-tarteeb aur bohat tezi se badalta hai, is liye naqsha aust ho kar yaksan roshni ban jata hai.

items: Interference ke liye aik qism, coherent, taqreeban aik simt ki lehrein.
Coherent sources: constant phase farq (do slits se bata aik laser).
